command.text: Completed setup for Casey (SK, age 29, 2026): salary CAD 48,000; opening bank 6,000, TFSA 3,500, RRSP 8,000. Selected 2.5% inflation-linked pay growth, 2.5% inflation, 7% annual returns, shared stop-work age 65; pension start ages defaulted to 65 and blank CPP/QPP share used the salary-based estimate. Entered CAD 2,400 monthly living costs plus CAD 250 monthly LOC payment = CAD 2,650 / CAD 31,800 annual expenses (no duplicate total). LOC CAD 11,000 balance and interest rate are not represented. Added Winter income buffer: CAD 9,000 by Dec 2027 using a dedicated savings schedule; screen explicitly says affordability is not checked and schedule amounts do not move money in projection. Tested RRSP/TFSA room with CAD 5,000 each as temporary fictional test inputs; the app previewed rough estimate alternatives but I cancelled them. Seasonal approximation: replaced take-home income with zero Jan-Mar and Nov-Dec, CAD 5,472 Apr-Oct (7 x 5,472 = CAD 38,304, the displayed annual take-home estimate), illustrating annual average versus cash timing. This is a net-pay approximation, not gross salary by month; annual gross/tax estimates remain based on CAD 48,000 salary. The zero-income months depleted cash to CAD 30 by March and triggered investment withdrawal in the initial unclosed projection. Closed January 2026 with a lesson. Exported and re-imported dated backup; verified household, two expenses, goal, closed month and lesson. Reload preserved the lesson. Browser errors list was empty. Corrected exploratory locator mistakes; those command failures are in the run log, no browser errors. Tax numbers were not independently verified; no tax concern filed. Not tested: offline behavior, multiple years of actual income history, debt principal/interest payoff, real CRA room, or external backups beyond local export/import.
